theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_lipschitz_graph_fibre_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (L : ℝ) (Γ : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N)) (G : Set (Euclidean N)) (g : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), 0 ≤ L → (∀ i, IsClosed (Γ i)) → (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ Γ i, ∀ z ∈ Γ i, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) → G ⊆ ⋃ i, Γ i → NullMeasurableSet G (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) → ∫⁻ y in G, g y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + L ^ 2) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) * ∫⁻ a in (P.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), (∑' y : {y : Euclidean N // y ∈ G ∧ Grassmannian.project P y = a}, g y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
